title: Sexist Men of Skyrim
description:
# Sexist Men of Skyrim

### — ⚠ *This is a proof of concept. The inception of a bigger package.*

## Overview
This mod is a spiritual successor to Sexist/Derogatory Guards & NPCs from LoversLab. While several mods already brush this theme, this package leverages **SkyrimNet’s generative AI** to create dynamic, context-aware interactions.

It brings back the raw, uncomfortable realism of casual misogyny in Skyrim. By replacing bland, generic background dialogue with frequent, explicit sexist remarks. Designed for players who want a darker, more immersive atmosphere where the patriarcha is loud and inescapable, it reflects a world where women have no business being adventurers.

### ***Compatibility with Pulse***
- You can bind this plugin with the ***Pulse*** Add-On.
 - Open the dashboard,
 - Open the *Settings* page,
 - Open the *Plugins* tab, select Pulse,
 - Activate Pulse's 3rd random timer.

 - Open the trigger the Behavior/Trigger Page,
 - Deactivate SDIO_IdleComments_Misogynists_Player,
 - Make sure SDIO_IdleComments_Misogynists_Player_Pulse is active,

 - You're good to go!


## Features
- **Dynamic Sexually Charged Comments:** Utilizes AI to replace standard guard background dialogue with context-specific, sexist remarks.

## Incompatibility & Warnings
- **Censored AI Models:** If your local AI model has strict safety filters enabled, it may refuse to generate the requested sexist content.
 - *Note: This is a limitation of the AI model itself, not the package.*

## Installation
Install from SkyrimNet plugin manager
